name: Fly Brain
description: Lets a fruit-fly connectome (FlyWire) play the level. Needs fly_server.py running on your PC.

enabled.name: Let the fly play
enabled.description: When on, the fly brain controls the jump button whenever fly_server.py is running.

speed.name: Training speed
speed.description: Runs the game faster while the fly is playing, so it gets more attempts per hour (1 = normal).
